<script>
function get(name){
			if(name=(new RegExp('[?&]'+encodeURIComponent(name)+'=([^&]*)')).exec(location.search))
				return decodeURIComponent(name[1]);
		};
		var cpoHeader = get('cpoHeader');
		if(cpoHeader != null && cpoHeader === 'false') {
			var hdr = document.getElementsByClassName('wdRem');
			if(hdr && hdr.length > 0) {
				hdr[0].style.display = 'none';
			}
		}
</script>

<div class="cm3-sp-heading" style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong></strong></span></div>
<p><img alt=""></p>
<div class="cm3-sp-heading" style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong><span style="font-size: 11.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Calibri',sans-serif; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-font-family: Calibri; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-theme-font: minor-bidi; color: #833c0b; mso-themecolor: accent2; mso-themeshade: 128; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;"><sup></sup></span></strong></span></div>
<div class="cm3-sp-heading" style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong></strong></span></div>
<div class="cm3-sp-heading" style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong></strong></span></div>
<div class="cm3-sp-heading" style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Thank you for your patience while we invest in CashPro.</strong></span></div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;"></div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;"></div>
<p style="text-align: center;"></p>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">While some mobile token features will be limited during offline maintenance,</div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">users can still manually generate a one-time password from their mobile token offline:</div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">1. Turn device to <strong>Airplane Mode</strong></div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">2. Open the <strong>CashPro App</strong></div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">3. Click &ldquo;<strong>Use Mobile Token</strong>&rdquo;</div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">4. Click &ldquo;<strong>Generate OTP</strong>&rdquo;</div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">5. Enter <strong>Mobile Token PIN</strong> or use biometrics if enabled</div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">A one-time password for token will be displayed.</div>
<p style="text-align: center;"></p>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;">Please contact your regional Bank of America CashPro Help Desk or Client Services contact for assistance.</div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;"><strong>CashPro Help Desk contact:</strong></div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;"><strong>ASIA</strong>: 09:00 ‒ 18:00 Singapore Time + 65 6678 3300</div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;"><strong>EMEA</strong>: 08:00 ‒ 18:00 GMT + 44 (0) 20 8313 2154</div>
<div class="cm3-sp-text" style="text-align: center;"><strong>USA and Canada</strong>: 8:00 a.m. ‒ 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time 1.888.589.3473, option 3</div>
